asset_origin: Synthetic SVG created by LaunchClear for this public capability sample.

findings.evidence: The summary shows 1,240 orders, 1,010 successful orders, and 190 failed orders. The visible outcomes total 1,200, leaving 40 orders unexplained.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing outcome category or correct the totals, then verify that all outcome counts sum to the order total.

findings.evidence: The Failed card begins 12 pixels lower than the other summary cards, breaking the shared baseline.
findings.recommendation: Align all summary cards to the same vertical origin and height.

findings.evidence: Retry and Failed use the same amber color, so color alone cannot distinguish the two outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Use distinct colors and add direct values or patterns so the chart remains interpretable without relying only on color.

findings.evidence: The label uses very light gray text on white and is truncated as Average order val..., reducing readability and precision.
findings.recommendation: Increase contrast and provide the complete label Average order value.

findings.evidence: Unclear payment status is visibly truncated, and no expansion mechanism is shown.
findings.recommendation: Allow the row label to wrap or expose the full value with an accessible details control.

acceptance_checks: Summary outcome counts reconcile to total orders.
All four summary cards share the same top and bottom alignment.
Each chart outcome has a distinct visual encoding and a direct text label.
All labels meet normal text contrast guidance and display their complete meaning.
Queue reasons remain readable at the target viewport without unexplained truncation.
